summary: Ground explicit dotted Paragraph, Clause and Article identifiers as atomic typed values and keep them scoped to workflows, source findings and Paragraph locators.
decision_refs: The active goal requires continued RFI, Submittal and Email accuracy and adaptability
Project Q&A already exposes Paragraph evidence locators
An offline reproduction proved that numeric-component validation accepted a paragraph recombined from two cited identifiers
approval_evidence: The persistent objective authorizes deterministic answer-accuracy improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
known_limitations: Only explicit Paragraph/Para, Clause and Article forms with two to six dotted numeric groups and an optional terminal letter are interpreted.
Unlabelled, undotted, date-shaped and Section-prefixed values remain outside this guard.
The guard does not determine hierarchy, applicability, contractual authority, precedence or whether every relevant file was parsed.
